title: ChatGPT has a feature to help those in crisis. But where can you find it?
summary: Earlier this year, OpenAI launched a feature on ChatGPT meant to help people at risk of suicide connect with someone they trust for support. But its setup may prove challenging to someone in crisis.
contentText:
